name: IMB
summary: A historical water Cherenkov detector in an Ohio salt mine searched for nucleon decay and observed the neutrino burst from Supernova 1987A.
detection_principle: Photomultiplier timing and light patterns reconstructed charged particles in a large water volume. Electronics and photodetector upgrades improved energy response and particle identification.

results.summary: Eight events associated with SN1987A were observed in IMB, independently supporting the supernova-neutrino interpretation.
Flavour-ratio and muon-decay studies contributed to the developing atmospheric-neutrino anomaly.
